name: 3D Texture Upload — 3D Texture Upload for Volume Data, GL_TEXTURE_3D volume upload, Volume Texture Binding
definition: Converts a 3D image stack from a nested array structure to a flat 1D Uint8Array buffer for GPU upload.
summary: This method uploads classified RGBA volume data from CPU to GPU by flattening nested arrays into a single monolithic GL_TEXTURE_3D object, distinct from atlas-based approaches.
